summary: Pembina Pipeline Corp, via its 6-K filing on July 2, 2026, announced a positive final investment decision on the Greenlight Electricity Centre (GLEC), a 932 MW gas-fired power facility in Alberta to support a data centre. Terms include a ~$4.6 billion total project cost (~$2.3 billion net to Pembina), with ~$2.1 billion net investment after a $190 million land sale. GLEC operates under a long-term tolling agreement with capacity and usage payments, targeting an in-service date in H2 2030. The project is expected to generate ~$310 million net annual run-rate adjusted EBITDA. This is a project development announcement, not a special situation—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
